title: elatostema caulialatum
intro:
Elatostema caulialatum, commonly known as the Asian tear thrombosis grass or Asian tear thrombosis plant, is a species of flowering plant in the nettle family Urticaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including hemorrhage and thrombosis. The health benefits of Elatostema caulialatum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anticoagulant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in promoting blood circulation and preventing blood clotting. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
